title: Announcing our Partners page
summary: Centralize lease data, collect utilization/attendance insights, track office-related invoices, and manage on-demand coworking programs. announcing-our-partners-page
body_markdown:
Over the last several months,[FlexDesk](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/#) has been organically partnering with tenant rep advisors.


‍


We serve the same audience, and in incredibly complimentary ways. It makes a ton of sense to work alongside one another and deliver amazing client outcomes together.


‍


As such, we've now formalized this partnership model on the FlexDesk website!


‍


If you are a tenant rep broker, check out our Partners page to learn how you and your clients can benefit from FlexDesk - across the full lifecycle of real estate management.


‍


This includes 👇


‍


📝 Planning: to provide an informed, data-driven viewpoint


‍


🤝 Collaborating: to reduce offline data-sharing practices


‍


💵 Transacting: to identify high-and-low utilization locations


‍


🏢 Managing: to automate manual processes and deliver superior client services


‍


Get in touch with any questions or to initiate a conversation.


‍
